title: Series 76 Overview and Enclosure Types (Weatherproof vs Explosionproof)
content: Series 76 heavy-duty electric actuators are used in industrial automation to open, close, or precisely control valves and dampers in HVAC and industrial processing plants. Enclosure Types: 1) Weatherproof: Designed for general industrial use, protected against dust, rain, and environmental elements (compliant with CSA, CE, & UKCA standards; note that Sizes 6 and 7 in 220V Single Phase are not CSA certified). 2) Explosionproof: Built for hazardous environments where flammable gases or dust may be present, certified CSA, IECEx/ATEX: Class I, Division 1, Groups C, D, T4; Ex d IIB T4 Gb; Class I, Zone 1, AEx d IIB T4 Gb.

title: Power Supplies and Application Service Types (On/Off vs Modulating)
content: Power Supply Options: 24V AC/DC (low voltage), 24V DC (modulating explosionproof), 110V Single Phase (North American standard), 220V Single Phase (international standard), and 220V 3 Phase (industrial three-phase; note that sizes 761A, 761B, 762A, and 762B are N/A in 3-phase). Application Types: On/Off actuators operate in two positions (fully open or fully closed) and specify Cycles per Hour. Modulating actuators stop at any point in their 90-degree rotation for precise flow control and specify Starts per Hour.

title: Definitions of Torque, Duty Cycle (S4%), Speed, FLA, LRA, and Motor Power
content: Output Torque: Rotational force measured in in-lbs and Nm. Duty Cycle (S4%): Percentage of time the actuator can operate over a cycle without overheating per IEC 60034-1. Operating Speed (Sec): Time to complete a 90-degree turn (varies between 50 Hz and 60 Hz for AC models). Full Load Current (FLA): Current in Amps drawn under maximum rated load. Locked Rotor Current (LRA): Current in Amps drawn by the motor at startup (locked rotor load), higher than FLA. Motor Power: Internal motor power rating in Watts (15W, 40W, 90W, 180W, or 700W).

title: Electrical Tolerances (+/-10% Voltage, +/-5% Frequency) and Certification Rules
content: Engineering Notes across all Series 76 tables: 1. Full load current (FLA) = Max. rated load. 2. Locked rotor current (LRA) @ Locked rotor load. 3. Allowable motor voltage tolerance is +/- 10% (e.g., 110V models operate safely from 99V to 121V; 220V models from 198V to 242V; 24V models from 21.6V to 26.4V). 4. Allowable power frequency tolerance is +/- 5% (50Hz: 47.5-52.5Hz; 60Hz: 57-63Hz). 5. Duty cycle per IEC 60034-1 for on/off and modulating service. 6. Starts and cycles per hour are based on rated torque. 7. Sizes 6 and 7 (models 766A00, 766B00, 767A00, 767B00, 767C00) are NOT CSA Certified.
